verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE investigates incidents using the customer's logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events. It suggests hypotheses, AI-based Linear ticket suggestions, suggested-fix pull requests and automated post-mortems, and answers natural-language requests for logs and charts. It is available via online chat as well as Slack. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation (all evidence is marketing-page claims), a clearer description of the in-dashboard insight surface (most of the evidence emphasizes Slack and MCP), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
Downtime? Create Linear tickets to fix the root cause using AI-based suggestions with a single tap.
Get recent logs or chart visualizations by simply asking in natural language.
Chat online, inside Slack and in Claude Code using the MCP
Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
